name: Test-first implementation
goal: Implement the approved plan as small test-first changes and leave observed test evidence.
trigger: An owner hands off an approved plan as the implementation target.
customer_rules: Observe the failing test first and confirm the failure reason links to a requirement.
Change only the minimal code needed, then run the same test and related regression tests.
Do not record tests as passing if they were not run or their results were lost.
External publishing, PR creation, merging, and deployment are outside this workflow's scope.

steps.name: Implement with red-green-refactor
steps.completion: The implementation within the plan scope and the real failing, passing, and regression test results are all recorded.
steps.failure: If a test fails or cannot run, record the command and observed result and stop as failed or blocked.

checks: Do not add changes absent from the plan before separate approval.
Do not start without an input plan.

traceability.requirement: Leave test results as observed facts.
checks: Red and green results are recorded with their commands.
Regression tests that could not run remain unverified.
